title: Smothered Onion Chicken

items.item: salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, maple syrup (to taste)

instructions: Mix the onions, onion soup mix, brown sugar, oil, and pepper in a bowl.
Put a layer of onions on the bottom of a big roasting pan. Lay the chicken on top and sprinkle with garlic powder and paprika, then cover with the rest of the onion mixture.
Cover the chicken tightly with foil and bake at around 350°F for at least an hour and a half. The longer you cook it covered, the more tender the final product will be.
Uncover, drizzle on some maple syrup, and bake for another ½ hour or so, basting at least once with the juices.
notes: The chicken tastes best if you let it marinate in the onion mixture overnight, as the onions release their juices and add lots more onion flavor; if marinated overnight, increase the cooking time by another 45 minutes.
